canada.title: Montreal police seek help locating missing 72-year-old woman who could be disoriented
canada.summary: Montreal police are seeking the public's help to locate Leonne Aneus, a 72-year-old woman missing since Saturday afternoon.

canada.title: Outspoken UCP MLA Shane Getson leaving Alberta’s legislature
canada.summary: A plainspoken, two-term United Conservative backbencher who has at times courted controversy and riled up the Opposition NDP is resigning his seat in Alberta’s legislature.

canada.title: Trial for Sundre woman accused of sexually assaulting teenager begins
canada.summary: A two-week trial got underway Monday for Alexa Suitor, who is accused of sexually assaulting a 15-year-old boy.

canada.title: Gillingham vows to keep future property tax hikes near inflation; Klein points to opponent's past promises
canada.summary: Winnipeg mayoral candidate Scott Gillingham reiterated his promise to raise property taxes by 3.5 per cent in 2027 and promised to keep future annual tax hikes "close" to inflation.

canada.title: Crown withdraws criminal charges against Montreal protesters arrested at bank sit-in
canada.summary: On Monday, the Crown dropped criminal charges against pro-Palestinian protesters arrested during a sit-in at a downtown Montreal bank in 2024, ending a legal battle that protesters say raises broader questions about the right to demonstrate.

canada.title: Manitoban denied out-of-province care for rare condition says he's 'tortured every single day'
canada.summary: A Manitoba man living with a rare genetic condition says he's now considering medically assisted dying, after being denied out-of-province coverage to get a procedure he and experts say he can't get here.

canada.title: 'Time to abolish the Indian Act,' Manitoba premier tells PM in historic meeting with chiefs
canada.summary: Manitoba Premier Wab Kinew is calling on the federal government to abolish the Indian Act, in a move that saw a warm reception from some but drew criticism elsewhere.

canada.title: Polling stations across Toronto to close at 8 p.m., results expected to be close. Live election updates here
canada.summary: It is election day in Ontario, with voters set to elect new mayors, city councillors and school trustees in municipalities across the province.

canada.title: Carney open to conversations around ‘moving beyond’ the Indian Act
canada.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney said on Monday that he's opening to 'moving beyond' or abolishing the Indian Act.

canada.title: Supporters rally as historic youth-led climate trial begins in Vancouver
canada.summary: Crowds of supporters gathered outside the Federal Court building in Vancouver on Monday in solidarity with plaintiffs in Canada's first youth-led climate trial.

canada.title: Moncton council asks for short-term rental rules
canada.summary: Moncton councillors have asked city staff to draft a bylaw regulating short-term rentals like Airbnb and Vrbo.

canada.title: Yukon Artists at Work acquires funding for outdoor projects next spring
canada.summary: Lotteries Yukon funding goes toward tents, tables and signage for outdoor space

canada.title: Uniqlo to move into old Nordstrom building in downtown Vancouver
canada.summary: Since Nordstrom closed, many have speculated as to what storefront could fill the space and last year it was announced that it would be divided into four units.

canada.title: Protest outside First Nations–First Ministers Meeting decry closed doors and ‘economic coercion’
canada.summary: A protest was held outside the First Nations-First Ministers Meeting in Ottawa over the lack of participation in the event.

canada.title: Brampton man arrested, charged in connection with fatal stabbing in Mississauga
canada.summary: A 35-year-old Brampton man has been arrested and charged in the stabbing death of a 47-year-old Bradford, Ont., man in Mississauga over the weekend.

canada.title: N.B. students unsure about federal bill to ban social media for youth under 16
canada.summary: Two students, one at Fredericton High School and one at Mount Allison University, agree that social media platforms are flawed, but disagree that a proposed solution to ban youth under 16 is the way to go.

canada.title: Ex-N.S. PC interim leader endorses another former Tory for Liberal leadership
canada.summary: A former interim leader of Nova Scotia's Progressive Conservatives has endorsed her former PC cabinet colleague to become the new provincial Liberal leader.

canada.title: Northerners among youth taking climate fight to federal court
canada.summary: Kira Young of Yellowknife and Leandrea Reeves of Whitehorse are among 15 young plaintiffs who've filed a lawsuit against the federal government over climate change. The trial is scheduled to begin Monday, where they'll argue the trajectory of greenhouse gas emissions causes harm and violates their rights.
